title: Etruscan alphabet
summary: Etruscan writers adapted western Greek letters into a script subsequently used as a model for Latin.

parents.reason: Western Greek letter forms supplied the inventory adapted for Etruscan sounds.

title: Nabataean script
summary: Nabataean Aramaic inscriptions used letter forms whose cursive development contributed to Arabic writing.

parents.reason: Nabataean writing adapted the Aramaic consonantal letter tradition.

title: Phonetic man’yōgana writing
summary: Japanese scribes used Chinese characters for their sounds to represent Japanese syllables.

title: Gupta script
summary: Northern Indian Brahmi forms developed distinctive Sanskrit inscriptional and manuscript conventions.

parents.reason: Gupta-period scribes modified the letter forms and vowel marking of Brahmi.

title: Siddhaṃ script
summary: Siddhaṃ developed post-Gupta letter forms used for Sanskrit texts and later regional writing traditions.

parents.reason: Gupta letter forms evolved into the post-Gupta Siddhaṃ inventory.

title: Early Nāgarī writing
summary: Northern Indian scribes developed Nāgarī forms ancestral to Devanagari and related scripts.

parents.reason: Siddhamātṛkā consonants, vowel signs, and ligatures supplied intermediate forms developed into Nāgarī.

title: Pallava script
summary: Southern Indian inscriptional letters supplied models adapted by several Southeast Asian writing traditions.

parents.reason: Pallava letter forms developed from the southern Tamil-Brahmi tradition.

title: Kawi script
summary: Kawi recorded Old Javanese and other languages in maritime Southeast Asian inscriptions and manuscripts.

parents.reason: Regional Pallava-derived letters became the more cursive Kawi forms used in inscriptions and documents.

title: Sogdian alphabet
summary: Sogdian writers adapted Aramaic-derived consonantal letters for Central Asian texts.

parents.reason: Aramaic-derived letter forms supplied the Sogdian inventory and its consonantal writing conventions.

title: Five Classics examination corpus
summary: Han institutions recognized the Five Classics as an authoritative body of texts for scholarly teaching.

parents.reason: Confucian teaching and commentary established the authority attributed to the classical texts.

title: Mishnah compilation
summary: Rabbinic scholars organized Jewish oral legal traditions into a written collection of topical tractates.

parents.reason: Jewish oral legal interpretation supplied the rulings and debates organized into the tractates.

title: Ivo’s canonical collections
summary: Collections associated with Ivo of Chartres assembled church rulings for legal consultation and reconciliation.

title: City Dionysia dramatic contests
summary: Athens organized festival competitions that gave tragedians a recurring setting for public performance.

title: Nāṭya Śāstra performance treatise
summary: A Sanskrit treatise systematized dramatic composition, gesture, music, and aesthetic response.

title: Partial Test Ban Treaty
summary: The treaty prohibited nuclear test explosions in the atmosphere, outer space, and underwater.

title: Vienna ozone convention
wiki: Vienna Convention for the Protection of the Ozone Layer
summary: States agreed a framework for research and cooperation on protecting the ozone layer.

title: UN climate framework convention
wiki: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
summary: The convention established continuing international negotiations and reporting on climate change.

parents.reason: The UN-convened negotiation and 1992 conference provided the process for adopting the framework treaty.

title: Caribbean Free Trade Association
summary: Caribbean governments operated a regional free-trade association later replaced by CARICOM.

title: Original East African Community
summary: Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda established a community to administer regional cooperation and shared services.

title: Trans-Pacific Partnership agreement
summary: Twelve governments signed a proposed Pacific trade agreement that did not enter into force.

title: American rights declaration
wiki: American Declaration of the Rights and Duties of Man
summary: American states adopted a regional declaration defining individual rights and duties.

parents.reason: The founding inter-American conference adopted the declaration within the new regional organization’s framework.

title: UN child-rights declaration
wiki: Declaration of the Rights of the Child
summary: The UN adopted ten principles addressing children’s protection, development, and access to education.

parents.reason: The universal declaration’s protections were elaborated into principles addressing children’s particular needs.

title: Inter caetera demarcation bull
summary: A papal bull asserted a demarcation of Spanish overseas claims that Spain and Portugal subsequently renegotiated.

title: International Law Commission
summary: The UN established an expert commission to draft and codify international legal rules.

parents.reason: The General Assembly created the commission under its Charter mandate to develop and codify international law.

title: European recovery coordination organization
summary: The OEEC coordinated European allocation of Marshall Plan assistance before its reconstitution as the OECD.

parents.reason: The allocation and administration of European recovery aid supplied the organization’s initial operational task.

title: Sufi devotional practice
summary: Sufi communities developed disciplines of remembrance, spiritual instruction, and devotional participation.

parents.reason: Islamic devotional teachings supplied the concepts and religious commitments elaborated in Sufi disciplines.

title: Binary musical form
summary: Composers organized pieces into two related sections, commonly repeated and linked through contrasting keys.

title: African American spirituals
summary: Enslaved African Americans developed devotional songs combining biblical subjects with communal musical practices.

title: UN declaration on women’s equality
wiki: Declaration on the Elimination of Discrimination Against Women
summary: The UN proclaimed principles against discrimination that preceded a binding women’s rights convention.

parents.reason: The declaration elaborated the universal declaration’s equal-rights principles into articles addressing discrimination against women.
